title: Domain architecture of the Mycobacterium tuberculosis MabR (Rv2242), a member of the PucR transcription factor family.
authors: Megalizzi, Veronique; Tanina, Abdalkarim; Grosse, Camille; Mirgaux, Manon; Legrand, Pierre; Dias Mirandela, Gaetan; Wohlkonig, Alexandre; Bifani, Pablo; Wintjens, Rene
one_liner_zh: 该文解析结核分枝杆菌PucR家族转录因子MabR的晶体结构，揭示其N端球状折叠与C端含HTH DNA结合基序的独特结构域组合及寡聚状态，属于TF-DNA互作的结构生物学研究，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，故评分为6。
abstract: MabR (Rv2242), a PucR-type transcription factor, plays a crucial role in regulating mycolic acid biosynthesis in Mycobacterium tuberculosis. To understand its regulatory mechanisms, we determined the crystal structures of its N-terminal and C-terminal domains. The N-terminal domain adopts a globin-like fold, while the C-terminal domain comprises an alpha/beta GGDEF domain and an all-alpha effector domain with a helix-turn-helix DNA-binding motif. This unique domain combination is specific to Actinomycetes. Biochemical and computational studies suggest that full-length MabR forms both dimeric and tetrameric assemblies in solution. Structural analysis revealed two distinct dimerization interfaces within the N- and C-terminal domains, further supporting a tetrameric organization. These findings provide valuable insights into the domain architecture, oligomeric state, and potential regulatory mechanisms of MabR.
abstract_zh: MabR（Rv2242）是一种PucR型转录因子，在结核分枝杆菌的霉菌酸生物合成调控中发挥关键作用。为理解其调控机制，我们解析了其N端和C端结构域的晶体结构。N端结构域采用珠蛋白样折叠，而C端结构域包含一个α/β GGDEF结构域和一个具有螺旋-转角-螺旋DNA结合基序的全α效应结构域。这种独特的结构域组合是放线菌门所特有的。生化和计算研究表明，全长MabR在溶液中形成二聚体和四聚体组装体。结构分析揭示了N端和C端结构域内两个不同的二聚化界面，进一步支持四聚体组织形式。这些发现为MabR的结构域架构、寡聚状态及潜在调控机制提供了宝贵见解。
